text:
alex: Heads up — LegalCorp needs a temporary routing override for their integration test. They want traffic with header `X-Tenant: legalcorp` to go to `paleo-model-v2` for ~6h. Can we do a fast-path from the console or admin API?

maria: We have per-org pins/allowlists but console UX today only supports persistent pins (days/weeks). Short-lived ad-hoc overrides aren't surfaced well. Audit + TTL missing.

sam: We have an admin endpoint that can create overrides but it's not exposed in the UI. Example payload I usually run from curl:```
POST /admin/routing/overrides
{
  "org_id": "legalcorp",
  "match": { "header": "X-Tenant", "value": "legalcorp" },
  "target": "model:paleo-v2",
  "expires_at": "2026-03-18T18:30:00Z",
  "meta": { "reason": "legal int test #42", "created_by": "sam" }
}
```
This would work if we can also ensure audit events and header-stripping.

jess: Main concerns: 1) spoofing (anyone can set X-Tenant), 2) telemetry + cost spikes, 3) leaking header upstream. We should require either an HMAC sig (X-Org-Sig) or require the request to hit our ingress with a routing token. Also strip the header before proxying.

alex: Yes to header stripping and signature. For quick rollout we can: 1) allow admin-created override but require `hmac_key_id` so gateway validates `X-Org-Sig`. 2) enforce `expires_at`. 3) write audit event `routing.override.created`.

maria: UX note: console should show a dedicated panel "Active ad-hoc overrides" with revoke + TTL countdown. Also show last 10 audit lines and the entitlement that allowed creation. Otherwise SRE/ops will be confused.

sam: Implementation plan I can take:
- admin-api: add "hmac_key_id","tags","reason" fields + server-side validation
- gateway: verify signature and strip both X-Tenant and X-Org-Sig before forwarding
- console: surface overrides list + create flow guarded by entitlement check
- events: emit `routing.override.created` / `routing.override.revoked` with org_id, creator, expires_at, tags
- metrics: counter `routing.overrides.active` and histogram for override duration
I can open a PR and a small DB migration.

jess: Also add quota precheck: if target model is expensive, block ad-hoc if org has no spend-limit or owner approval. Add a popup warning in console: "This override bypasses canary and fallback policies — proceed?"

infra-bot: Created ticket INF-3456: "ad-hoc routing overrides: hmac + ttl + console surface" assigned to @sam.

alex: Fine. Sam, if you can do a minimal safe path today (admin-api + gateway sig+strip + audit events) we can apply the override for LegalCorp. Make sure revocation is one click. Approve to apply now. :thumbsup:

sam: Will PR and run integration test. Applying minimal override now via admin API (will post result).

sam: (tool) POST /admin/routing/overrides -> 201 Created id=ovr_20260318_001, expires_in=6h

alex: Thanks — please add a short rollback playbook and a telemetry dashboard query we can share in the incident channel.

maria: I'll mock a console panel in Figma for the UX review tomorrow.

jess: Also add a pre-approve list for safety: only orgs on `ad-hoc-enabled` allowlist can use this. Add an allowlist audit export.

sam: Noted. PR will include tests for signature verification, header-stripping, and event emission.

alex: Good work. Keep the console warning clear — this is an escape hatch, not standard routing. :eyes:
